input.command:
# Start ALL infrastructure in parallel right now
# 1. Gradle build
cd /home/user/rork-app/android-ivx-holdings && nohup ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon --build-cache > /tmp/gradle-build.log 2>&1 &
G_PID=$!
echo $G_PID > /tmp/gradle-pid.txt
echo "Gradle: PID $G_PID"

# 2. Emulator binary
export ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk && export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=/opt/android-sdk
yes | /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager "emulator" > /tmp/emu-install.log 2>&1 &
E_PID=$!
echo $E_PID > /tmp/emu-pid.txt
echo "Emulator binary: PID $E_PID"

# 3. System image (android-30 default — lighter, no GMS, less system_server load)
yes | /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager "system-images;android-30;default;x86_64" > /tmp/sysimg-install.log 2>&1 &
S_PID=$!
echo $S_PID > /tmp/sysimg-pid.txt
echo "System image: PID $S_PID"

echo ""
echo "All 3 background tasks launched. Waiting for completion..."
